ui_scope: Native phone/light/dark/1.3-font/expanded captures. Fresh full review followed by three-fix verdict; all three resolved. Browser-only gates unsupported, not passed. No hardware frame-rate claim.
limitations: No physical test phone; Android 14+ target is not a guarantee for every OEM/kernel/firmware.
2-GB software-rendered AVD showed a System UI ANR; it recovered. Subsequent 4-GB/4-core checks passed without that prompt. Resource pressure is an inference, not a proven universal cause.
Not every AI provider was called with real credentials; third-party modules/WebUI/hiding modules require separate compatibility and source checks.
No physical partition was flashed. GKI inputs are user-compiled artifacts; the app does not build full kernels.
